def factor_volume_impact_asymmetry(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    up_impact = intraday_ret.clip(lower=0.0) * np.where(is_high_vol > 0, 1.0, 0.3)
    down_impact = (-intraday_ret.clip(upper=0.0)) * np.where(is_low_vol > 0, 1.0, 0.3)
    up_vol = up_impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).std()
    down_vol = down_impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).std()
    denom = (up_vol + down_vol).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = (up_vol - down_vol) / denom
    df_copy["factor_volume_impact_asymmetry"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_volume_impact_asymmetry"]
description: Liquidity-conditioned asymmetric price impact: on high-volume days, positive intraday moves reflect strong demand absorption; on low-volume days, negative moves reflect illiquidity-driven pressure. The EWM volatility asymmetry isolates volume-regime-dependent return pressure after controlling for overall volatility. This changes the raw information pathway from the prior asymmetric volatility factor by embedding volume-regime gating instead of using unconditional return signs.
